image_prompt.text: Each island given a distinct silhouette - a peak, a wreck, a tower - so players can navigate the seas by sight
Alcoves and clearings on the islands set aside for fruit to appear in
Open buildable ground on some islands where players can raise their own base
Three separate seas, each holding its own cluster of islands, with open water and a visible horizon between them

layout_placement.text: Fruit spawn points distributed across the island clusters
Unclaimed ground players can build on

notes: Three seas of escalating difficulty are genuinely separate regions and route P4; they cannot co-exist on one framed surface.
Sixty islands across three seas will not fit in a single top-down image at any usable resolution. The buildable alternative is one framed image per sea, or per island archetype, composed afterwards.

Genre note applies: this is the survival-RPG style, where danger is a gradient and player-versus-player risk exists everywhere, so no physical level gate was placed between the seas even though they scale.

open_questions.ask: No look was given - tropical and bright, or stormy and pirate-grim?
How big is one island - a beach you cross in ten seconds, or somewhere you spend a session?
Are the three seas one continuous ocean you can sail between, or separate places you teleport to?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the seas and islands look like?
How large is a single island?
Do players sail between seas, or are they separate places?
Is the bounty system the endgame, or is there something to beat?

answers.ask: No look was given - tropical and bright, or stormy and pirate-grim?
answers.answer: Make it tropical and bright, with colorful islands and a fun pirate-adventure look.

answers.ask: How big is one island - a beach you cross in ten seconds, or somewhere you spend a session?
answers.answer: Keep each island small, about a beach you can cross in ten seconds, so players can visit the many islands.

answers.ask: Are the three seas one continuous ocean you can sail between, or separate places you teleport to?
answers.answer: Make the three seas separate places that players teleport to.
